local_review.scope: Local review provenance only; no local intake file is required on the server.

controller_identity.limit: Piped controller bytes were not retained as an independent server file.

limits: Exactly 21 new processes complete a mixed 48-case matrix: 26 unchanged-module original PASS plus one pinned candidate replay PASS are reused.
Four original M65 Sign memcheck/initcheck PASS records are retired for the changed candidate; they do not contribute to the mixed matrix.
All eight M65 Sign matrix entries use the pinned CTA candidate; all other cells use their original V3 module/test.
Original E02b and completed single replay remain unchanged; no previous state, result, or pointer is updated.
Every new case keeps the original sanitizer argv, timeouts, H008-only environment, idle thresholds, T12 and saved-byte differential requirements.
Failure stops the new run; no case retries. Every unstarted new case remains NOT_RUN.
Only a new mixed sanitizer matrix is qualified. Original E02b still has its finding; full E02, production adoption and formal performance remain separate.
PQMagic SHAKE is the sole oracle; independent PQClean and official KAT are NOT_RUN.
Unrelated-stream nonserialization remains SKIPPED under instrumentation; all timings are diagnostic only.
racecheck covers shared-memory hazards, not all global races; no compiler-defect or false-positive claim is made.
When executed from stdin, script bytes are not independently retained or rehashed on the server.

checks.note: ML-DSA-44 challenge has no bytes beyond the 32-byte seed size.
